codebase.title: PyAbel: forward and inverse Abel transforms
codebase.fingerprint_algorithm: SHA-256 over typed sorted regular-file paths+bytes and symlink paths+safe targets

agent_authored.description: PyAbel reconstructs the meridional slice of a cylindrically symmetric three-dimensional distribution from a two-dimensional projection, and computes the forward projection. Ten transform methods and common image-centering, symmetry, circularization, radial-intensity and angular-anisotropy tools serve photoelectron and photoion imaging, plasma and flame diagnostics.

pitfalls.symptom: The direct C implementation is optional; a Python-only installation can appear successful while its two backend-comparison tests are skipped.
pitfalls.workaround: Preinstalled NumPy and Cython, built with --no-build-isolation, and verified abel.direct.cython_ext is True and abel.lib.direct imports from a compiled extension.

pitfalls.symptom: Tests and transform methods write basis caches; running from the vendored source could contaminate its exact upstream copy.
pitfalls.workaround: Built an independent scratch copy, tested the installed package with --pyargs from outside the checkout, and retained code/pyabel unchanged.

pitfalls.symptom: Examples load data relative to their working directory and open plots.
pitfalls.workaround: Ran from the scratch examples directory with MPLBACKEND=Agg and a separate Matplotlib cache; no image inputs were downloaded.

pitfalls.symptom: Native library thread pools and first-use caches affect wall-clock observations.
pitfalls.workaround: Set OMP_NUM_THREADS, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS, MKL_NUM_THREADS and VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS to 1. Reported times include process startup and any cache initialization and are build/run evidence, not comparative performance results.

pitfalls.symptom: Some upstream tests and example noise generators are unseeded.
pitfalls.workaround: Recorded this behavior without modifying upstream. These native passes do not establish cross-run identity; task input reproducibility will require separate design after source merge.

modules.title: Forward and inverse Abel transforms and image analysis
modules.expensive_path: Image-wide Abel reconstruction: basis construction and matrix multiplication, numerical integration, recursive transforms, regularized least squares, and extraction of radial and angular distributions. Cost depends on image dimensions, selected method and basis-cache state; no acceleration factor is claimed.
modules.rationale: The whole upstream package implements one scientific responsibility: reconstruction and interpretation of cylindrically symmetric image projections. Transform methods share the same image geometry, preprocessing, analytical data, integration tools, build and test suite. Alternative algorithms and helper directories are not independent scientific packages.
hazards: Basis matrices may be cached in memory or on disk; first-use and cached execution are different workloads.
Some official tests and examples draw random arrays or noise without a fixed seed.
NumPy and SciPy linear algebra, interpolation and nonlinear fitting can vary with BLAS, thread count, compiler and library version.
The optional Cython direct backend must be built explicitly and its availability checked.
Two Tk GUI examples require an interactive display; plot-only examples can use the Agg backend.
Different transform algorithms have different discretization errors and applicable symmetries; they must not be treated as interchangeable reference answers.
modules.purpose: One complete image-reconstruction and interpretation library, preserving all ten method choices and associated scientific conventions.
primary_inputs: Two-dimensional detector intensity arrays or one-dimensional radial profiles
Forward or inverse direction and method
Origin, spacing, quadrants and symmetry assumptions
Method-specific basis width, angular order, regularization and interpolation parameters
primary_outputs: Reconstructed or projected floating-point image arrays
Angular expansion coefficients and anisotropy distributions
Analytical reference profiles and associated projections
algorithm_stages: Center, shift, symmetrize or circularize the input using common image geometry.
Construct or retrieve method-specific basis matrices, quadrature data or recurrence coefficients.
Apply BASEX, direct quadrature, Hansen-Law recurrence, Dasch operators, Bordas onion peeling, lin-BASEX, rBASEX or Daun regularized inversion.
Reassemble image quadrants and extract radial intensities, energy spectra and angular anisotropy.
unique_responsibilities: Singular-kernel Abel transforms with method-specific sampling and regularization
Consistent image geometry and physically normalized velocity-map distributions
not_responsible_for: General three-dimensional tomography without cylindrical symmetry
Detector acquisition hardware or time-dependent plasma simulation
modules.differences: This is the only module. Algorithms, preprocessing and postprocessing share one scientific contract and are not split into separate tasks.
dependencies: Cython plus a C compiler for the optional direct backend
Matplotlib for plotting examples; Tk for interactive GUI examples
modules.classification: agent-authored module card; CLI-computed size and approval status
